In the main seven-bacteria LDA with the BA@L-HGNRs probe, **Factor 1 accounts for 99.9% of the total variance and Factor 2 for 0.1%**, which together make up essentially all of it (page 6; also shown on the axis labels of Fig. 2e, page 5). With these two factors, the clusters for the seven strains do not overlap (page 6).

The other seven-bacteria LDA plots split the variance differently:
- **UV–vis/RGB signals (Fig. 2g):** Factor 1 98.9%, Factor 2 1.0% (page 5)
- **Unfunctionalized L-HGNRs (Fig. 2h):** Factor 1 99.0%, Factor 2 0.9% (page 5)
- **Human serum matrix (Fig. 5b):** Factor 1 98.6%, Factor 2 1.2% (page 8)
question: What share of the total variance do the two discriminant factors account for in the seven-bacteria LDA?
